text.p: Oil product inventories held in independent tankage in the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp area were estimated to be at the following levels currently, a week ago and a year ago, industry sources said.
All figures in thousands of tonnes:
Motor gasoline stocks rose slightly as incoming cargoes outweighed vessel departures to the UK and barges to Germany.

Gas oil stocks increased as product arrived from the former Soviet Union (FSU), the United States and the Mediterranean. The effect could increase next week as the barging for the record IPE delivery should begin.
Fuel oil inventories dipped as no cargoes arrived, but product left for the bunker market. Jet fuel stocks were steady with some product leaving to be blended with gas oil.
